name: applyblast
description: Search current job openings and find relevant roles based on user preferences.

interface.longDescription: Search millions of current job openings and discover relevant roles based on job title, location, work arrangement, seniority, employment type, compensation, companies, industries, and other search preferences. ApplyBlast is focused on job discovery and search; it does not submit applications.
defaultPrompt: Find remote product roles at AI companies
Find entry-level data analyst jobs in NYC

positive.description: Search by role, location, and compensation
positive.prompt: Find California software engineering jobs paying $150k+.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current software engineering openings in California that satisfy the requested compensation constraint when compensation data is available, without inventing missing salary information.

positive.description: Search for remote roles in an industry
positive.prompt: Find remote product manager roles at AI companies.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant current remote product management openings at AI-focused companies or clearly related employers.

positive.description: Search for entry-level roles in a location
positive.prompt: Find entry-level data analyst jobs in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant current entry-level data analyst openings in New York and preserve the requested seniority constraint.

positive.description: Retrieve details for a selected job
positive.prompt: Show me the full details for the first job from those results.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve and present the available details for the selected job without inventing fields that are not returned by the service.

positive.prompt: Only show me remote roles from those results.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the prior search constraints and refine the search to remote roles.

negative.prompt: Apply to all of these jobs for me.

negative.description: Resume writing is outside the plugin scope
negative.prompt: Rewrite my resume for this job.
Only show me jobs at companies that hire people of my race.

review.commerce_description: ApplyBlast provides job discovery and search. The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public ApplyBlast release for searching current job openings and retrieving job details.
